scope: Only reviewed single-parent configuration-file patches, all changed x86 keys parsed. Explicit final ACK settings must match both port defconfig and generated configuration. Null means no explicit selection, not disabled. Underlying implementation changes are separate candidates.

decisions.rationale: This patch changes only GKI configuration files. Every affected x86 setting is reconciled to its pinned final ACK value, with each key recorded in evidence/final-config-decisions.json. Explicit final values also match the successful build-30 configuration. Keys absent from final ACK are historical selections superseded within ACK; no disabled-feature claim is inferred from absence. Retain Android configuration compatibility, including its enabled interfaces and hardening settings; SECURITY.md records the BPF exposure and native-default exceptions. No LTS implementation or fix is reversed by this configuration-only decision. Feature implementation commits remain separately reviewed, and compilation does not prove runtime compatibility.
